falsifier_requirement.trigger: Heldout behavior/psychometric metrics leak into model selection, fewer than 20 subjects are scored, dataset hashes drift, or training-mean comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Fit a training-only mixed-effects behavioral model from visible trial condition, prior trial history, age/sex/site covariates, and training-subject psychometric summaries; score heldout subject metrics once.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: predict heldout RT/success metrics by the training-only condition and covariate-stratum mean
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Extend the existing domain scorer script with concrete flags for this phenomenon and bind them in COMPARATOR_DOMAIN_IMPLEMENTED_COMMANDS.

required_source_block.source_authority: OpenNeuro / OpenfMRI / Center for Reproducible Neuroscience
required_source_block.source_name: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c Study

residual_requirement.formula: absolute RT residual in ms and absolute success-rate residual per subject

target_variable.extraction_rule: BIDS behavior/event files are parsed into subject-level task metrics; heldout subject metrics and psychometric targets remain sealed until prediction rows are written.
target_variable.name: heldout_stop_signal_behavioral_performance

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute RT residual in ms and absolute success-rate residual per subject
uncertainty_requirement.rule: subject bootstrap with trial-count weighting and preregistered missingness rules

why_it_failed: The domain scorer script exists, but this domain/phenomenon has no bound acquisition/scoring/replay flags.
